mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% signals persistent monetary accommodation, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% triggers market anticipation of central bank stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as investors price in policy intervention.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (HOUST * RSAFS) yields negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are negative when both series exceed 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100 indicates manufacturing sector strength, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Rising housing starts (HOUST) consistently precede economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days through improved consumer confidence and spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate exceeding 0.1% signals monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Positive interaction between employment growth (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * (1/UNRATE)) yields negative Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative when PAYEMS is above 12-month average and UNRATE is below 7.0.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth exceeding 400,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000 million dollars.
